Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/gpt_4o/react/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/aluminum_melting_1_trial_4/analyze_msd.py", "content": "
import MDAnalysis as mda
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD
import numpy as np

# Load the trajectory
u = mda.Universe('/results/gpt_4o/react/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/aluminum_melting_1_trial_4/aluminum_structure.data',
                 '/results/gpt_4o/react/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/aluminum_melting_1_trial_4/trajectory.lammpstrj',
                 format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Select all atoms
atoms = u.select_atoms('all')

# Calculate MSD
msd = EinsteinMSD(atoms, msd_type='xyz', fft=true)
msd.run()

# Extract MSD values
msd_values = msd.results.msd

# Identify the melting point
melting_point_frame = np.argmax(np.diff(msd_values[50000:])) + 50000

# Calculate diffusion constant (D) in the molten state
time_step = 0.001  # in picoseconds
time = np.arange(len(msd_values)) * time_step
D = np.polyfit(time[melting_point_frame:], msd_values[melting_point_frame:], 1)[0] / 6

# Print the diffusion constant
print(f"{D:.2e}")
"}
